title: Island Trails of Phuket, Koh Samui and Krabi
alt: Long tail boats anchored off a limestone island in the Andaman Sea
transport: Shared coach transfers with long tail boat, speedboat and ferry crossings

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Three islands in six nights, with the Full Moon Party in the middle. It suits travellers in their twenties best.
expert.tip: The party runs all night on Koh Phangan and the boat back is in the early hours, so day four is deliberately empty. Keep valuables in the hotel safe and carry cash in a waterproof pouch.

summary: Seven days along the Thai coast with two nights each in Phuket, Koh Samui and Krabi. Long tail boat island hopping off Phi Phi, the Full Moon Party on Koh Phangan and a speedboat tour of the Krabi 4 Islands, with all meals covered on Samui.
included: Included: 6 nights in 3 four star hotels; daily breakfast, plus lunch and dinner on both Koh Samui nights; Phi Phi island hopping by long tail boat with island fees; Full Moon Party at Koh Phangan with shared transfer; Krabi 4 Islands speedboat tour with lunch and island fees; 17 airport, pier and island transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Phuket to Koh Samui flight; visa charges; travel insurance; drinks; lunches and dinners other than those listed; personal expenses.

day_titles.3: On to Koh Samui and the Full Moon Party

1: Arrival at Phuket International Airport and private sedan transfer to the Andakira
Check in near Patong and keep the first day completely free
Optional: Bangla Road after dark or the shophouse streets of Old Phuket Town
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer down to Tonsai pier
Long tail boat transfer around the Phi Phi islands through the morning
Island fees are covered, so every swimming stop is already paid for
Return shared transfer to your Phuket hotel in the afternoon
3: Breakfast, check out and private transfer to Phuket airport
Optional: flight from Phuket to Koh Samui, booked separately and not included
Private transfer from Samui airport to Baan Laimai on Chaweng beach
Lunch and dinner at the resort are included on both Samui nights
Evening speedboat transfer across to Koh Phangan for the Full Moon Party
4: Speedboat transfer back to Samui in the early hours, then sleep in
Breakfast, lunch and dinner at the resort with nothing else booked
Chaweng beach is right outside, with loungers and shade all day
Optional: a fire dance show on the sand or the stalls at The Wharf Samui
5: Breakfast, check out and shared transfer to the Samui pier
Ferry transfer across to the mainland, then on to Ao Nang
Check in at the Arawan Beach Resort and take the evening slowly
Optional: the Krabi weekend night market, cheap and very good
6: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the Ao Nang pier
Speedboat transfer out to Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island
Snorkel the shallows and walk across to Phra Nang beach, lunch included
Island fees are covered, return shared transfer in the afternoon
7: Breakfast and a slow check out
Private sedan transfer to Krabi airport for your trip home
